text.headline: Timeline of Tuvalu
text.text: Major events in the history of Tuvalu.

events.headline: Polynesian Settlement
events.text: Polynesian navigators settle the islands and develop distinct cultures.

events.headline: First European Contact
events.text: Álvaro de Mendaña sights the islands while exploring the Pacific.

events.headline: British Protectorate
events.text: Ellice Islands become a British protectorate.

events.headline: Colony of Gilbert and Ellice
events.text: Britain merges the Ellice and Gilbert Islands as one colony.

events.headline: Separation from Gilbert Islands
events.text: Tuvalu votes to separate from the Gilberts (now Kiribati).

events.headline: Independence
events.text: Tuvalu becomes fully independent within the Commonwealth.

events.headline: Climate Diplomacy
events.text: A leading global voice for climate action and sea-level rise awareness.

events.headline: Digital Nation Initiative
events.text: Building a digital twin to preserve national identity against climate displacement.
